dataset_business_purpose: To store basic organizational information mapping employees to their respective departments.

business_meaning_of_every_column.name: The full name of the employee.
business_meaning_of_every_column.dept: The name of the department where the employee works.

data_quality_concerns: Using employee 'name' as a primary key is risky due to potential name collisions (duplicate names for different employees).
The dataset lacks a unique employee identifier (surrogate or natural ID).
Department is stored as a string instead of a normalized department ID or code, which could lead to inconsistent naming/spelling.
